text:
cecilia: quick follow-up from today's all-hands. need a simple sequencing call for API / Console / Optimize so product can lock sprints. main Qs: is API GA a hard pre-req for Optimize? which environment gets Optimize first? any blockers we should call out?

michael: short version: API GA target unchanged (6/30). Optimize ships to Hosted first. Console parity is important but not a hard blocker for Optimize P1.

sam: product details: Optimize P1 = batching hints + quantization suggestions + UI panel. Hosted experimental by mid-June, full Hosted GA after API GA telemetry. Dedicated depends on billing hooks.

trina: eng note: Dedicated billing is the main blocker. infra can do a minimal read-only recommendations path for Dedicated if product wants earlier availability.

michael: ops note: we'll require a 10% canary with rollback plan for any Optimize rollout. ops-bot: staging deploy scheduled 02:00 UTC tomorrow.

cecilia: action items: sam updates roadmap with owners/dates (EOD). trina + infra to propose Dedicated shim options (48h). michael to share canary runbook. i'll expect the updated board link in this thread. :+1:
